name: Refined LLC
description: At Refined LLC, we are revolutionizing the finish construction industry in Albuquerque, New Mexico, by setting a new benchmark for excellence. Conveniently hosting services such as: flooring, carpentry, tile, painting, etc., all under one team you can trust. We pride ourselves on exceptional customer communication, ensuring transparency and collaboration that sets us apart from our competitors.
mission: Our mission is to create exceptional spaces that enhance people's lives, combining innovative design, superior quality craftsmanship, and an unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction.
